title: Contacts import under a minute
outcome: Importing a 10,000-row contacts export takes under 60 s of production database time, and bad rows are still reported while the rest import.

criteria.behavior: Importing data/contacts.csv accounts under 60,000 ms in db usage().
A row without an email is reported with its line number and every other row is imported.

challenge.simplest: Keep the importer and make it faster.
failureModes: Speed-ups lose the per-row error report

IM-1.2: test:test/import.test.js#imports the export and reports the bad row

log: 🟡 Round 1 (2026-10-17): 300 s of database time for data/contacts.csv (target 60 s). Added an in-memory dedupe cache.
🟡 Round 2 (2026-10-18): 300 s after the dedupe cache and trimming the parse (target 60 s). Next idea: tune the cache.
